title: Atomic forcing truth needs a common refinement and a genuine dense decision set.
details: Revision 2026-01-31, Lemma25.4, printed/PDF p.101. In the membership converse, a condition forcing equality to a subname need not extend that subname's attached condition. Choose their common stronger condition inside G before concluding forced membership. In the equality converse, the displayed counterwitness set need not be dense globally; use the dense union of conditions forcing equality and conditions carrying a local subset counterwitness. Under the assumption that no condition in G forces equality, meeting this union gives the counterwitness branch. Both repairs preserve the intended simultaneous-rank induction; the corpus must supply them explicitly if it adopts this presentation.
